data.description:
Addendum and correction to existing finding #60. The earlier entry associated pid 4210003701 with Quebec timber/Q867. Verified metadata identifies that as childcare/Q309; the timber table is 3810010601. The following precise task matches replace that unverified mapping, without endorsing a pre-launch evaluation or common-operator claim.

A review of retained Arquivo.pt records found precise correspondence between historical requests and the inputs required by public DeepSearchQA questions. The strongest three groups contain 101 distinct archive records, with 21 in August and 80 in September 2026 (UTC). These are repeated captured requests, not 101 users, questions, independent runs, or successful downloads.

Question 867 asks about Quebec timber-area categories with the largest growth from 1961 to 1962. Forty-four strict records, dated August 27–September 19, select Statistics Canada table 38-10-0106-01, Quebec, all eight timber categories and those exact years. Question 272 concerns regional decline in domestic environmental/clean-technology service revenue between 2017 and 2023. Thirty-two records, August 26–September 8, select table 38-10-0087-01, all seven subnational regions and Total services. Question 309 concerns affordability of before/after-school childcare in eastern provinces in 2022. Twenty-five records, September 1–13, select table 42-10-0037-01, the five provinces east of Ontario, the specified population, affordability and percentages. Official table metadata resolves the numeric selectors. The strict counts exclude wrong geography, unclear selectors and full-table requests lacking the required constraints.

The evidence links provide representative captured URLs and the pinned official benchmark CSV. The three representative archive links are indexed as HTTP 403; their significance is the unusually specific requested inputs, not successful retrieval. Other records have different outcomes, and an HTTP 200 alone does not establish correct data. No calculation or final answer is proven by these URLs. Six byte-identical URL groups also recur across August and September, showing reuse of request material without identifying who reused it.

The benchmark was public in December 2025, before these 2026 events; the December 17 release is byte-identical to the pinned CSV used in the review. The finding therefore does not establish pre-release leakage. It is compatible with formal evaluation, copied benchmark questions, human research, or investigator reproduction. No original prompt, runner log, authenticated operator, model or provider was recovered. This is a bounded, already-reviewed source/task correspondence finding, not a claim that the archive is a newly untapped source.
data.summary: August–September 2026 archive requests closely match three DeepSearchQA questions' precise datasets, years, regions and categories: 101 strict records. The correspondence does not identify a benchmark runner, successful answer, model or provider.
